question.text: Under the RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), a resident Indian investor can remit up to USD _______ per person per financial year for permissible current and capital account transactions including investment in an offshore fund.

explanation.text: The Logic: LRS allows resident Indians to remit up to USD 2,50,000 per person per financial year for permissible current and capital account transactions (or combination), subject to FEMA conditions. The Trap: USD 50,000 and USD 1,00,000 are below the workbook figure. USD 5,00,000 is fabricated. The figure stated in the workbook is USD 2,50,000. Note: The workbook (p. 126) specifies the LRS cap of USD 2,50,000 per person per financial year for permissible current and capital account transactions.
